sources.title: ghananlpcommunity/stable-twi-tts · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is driven by IPA phonemes rather than orthography, which is what lets one model serve both languages from a shared inventory. Warm-started from en_US/libritts_r/medium and finetuned on 327 h (164 h Twi + 164 h Ghanaian English), 22.05 kHz, 1,555 speaker embeddings.
